planets.name: Sun
planets.description: The Sun is the star at the center of our Solar System. It is a massive ball of hydrogen and helium that provides light and heat to all the planets.
facts: The Sun contains 99.86% of the Solar System's mass
Surface temperature is about 5,500°C (10,000°F)
It takes light 8 minutes to travel from the Sun to Earth
The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old
It will continue to shine for another 5 billion years

planets.name: Mercury
planets.description: Mercury is the smallest and innermost planet in the Solar System. It has no moons and is covered in craters.
facts: Mercury has no moons
A day on Mercury lasts 59 Earth days
Mercury has the most extreme temperature variations
It's the second densest planet after Earth
Mercury has a very thin atmosphere called an exosphere

planets.name: Venus
planets.description: Venus is the second planet from the Sun and is often called Earth's sister planet due to similar size and mass.
facts: Venus rotates backwards compared to most planets
It has the hottest surface temperature of any planet
Venus has no moons
A day on Venus is longer than its year
Venus is covered in thick clouds of sulfuric acid

planets.name: Earth
planets.description: Earth is our home planet and the only known planet with life. It has one natural satellite, the Moon.
facts: Earth is the only planet known to have life
It has one moon called Luna
Earth's atmosphere is 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen
About 71% of Earth's surface is covered in water
Earth's magnetic field protects us from solar radiation

planets.name: Mars
planets.description: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun and is often called the Red Planet due to its reddish appearance.
facts: Mars has the largest volcano in the Solar System, Olympus Mons
It has two moons: Phobos and Deimos
Mars has seasons like Earth
The red color comes from iron oxide (rust) on its surface
Mars has the largest canyon system, Valles Marineris

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.description: Jupiter is the largest planet in our Solar System and is a gas giant with no solid surface.
facts: Jupiter is the largest planet in our Solar System
It has at least 79 moons
The Great Red Spot is a storm that has raged for over 300 years
Jupiter has the strongest magnetic field of any planet
If Jupiter were much larger, it could have become a star

planets.name: Saturn
planets.description: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and is famous for its spectacular ring system.
facts: Saturn has the most extensive ring system in the Solar System
It has at least 82 moons
Saturn is less dense than water - it would float in a giant ocean
The rings are made mostly of ice particles
Saturn's moon Titan is larger than Mercury

planets.name: Uranus
planets.description: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and is an ice giant with a unique sideways rotation.
facts: Uranus rotates on its side with an axial tilt of 98 degrees
It has 27 known moons
Uranus was the first planet discovered with a telescope
It has 13 faint rings
A day on Uranus lasts 17 hours, but a year lasts 84 Earth years

planets.name: Neptune
planets.description: Neptune is the eighth and farthest planet from the Sun. It's an ice giant with the strongest winds in the Solar System.
facts: Neptune has the strongest winds in the Solar System, reaching 2,100 km/h
It has 14 known moons
Neptune was discovered through mathematical predictions
It has a Great Dark Spot similar to Jupiter's Great Red Spot
A year on Neptune lasts 165 Earth years

planets.name: Pluto
planets.description: Pluto is a dwarf planet in the Kuiper Belt. Though no longer classified as a planet, it remains an important celestial body.
facts: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006
It has five known moons, including Charon
Pluto's orbit is highly elliptical
It's smaller than Earth's moon
Pluto has a heart-shaped glacier on its surface
